specs.title: all five Advanced toggles are present and none is inert
"Simulate voice coil inductance" moves the acoustic response and tracks the circuit model
"Force flat response" flattens the SPL curve and charges the boost to excursion
the transmission-line port model changes port behaviour, and is offered only for a vented box
"Rg is at driver side" moves the response once more than one driver is wired
"SPL graph is Xmax limited" swaps the plotted curve for the achievable one
the Advanced toggles survive a reload — they are design state, not view state
app shell renders — side panel and graph grid are populated
in-browser self-test passes all three physics gates
box type change to sealed re-renders enclosure panel
box type change to vented shows vent controls
End-correction selector retunes the vent Fb — BoxPanel AND StatBar agree (shared, Modern/Classic)
shared BoxPanel reads decimal places from the field registry (vent diameter = 2 dp)
share link encodes state in URL hash
sealed box: Fs=37Hz, Qts=0.38, Vas=30L driver in 20L box shows Qtc=0.601 and fc=58.5Hz in stat bar
sealed box: Fs=37Hz,Qts=0.38,Vas=30L — Butterworth button sets Vb so stat bar shows Qtc=0.707 and fc=68.8Hz
vented box: 30L box with 5cm bore, 10cm port tunes to Fb=37.9Hz (Helmholtz resonator)
bandpass4 box: 15L rear + 20L front + ø5cm×10cm port — stat bar shows box:bandpass4, Vb:15.0L and peak port velocity
passive radiator: 30L box, 50g PR, 0.5mm/N Cms — stat bar shows Fp=37.9Hz
Modern skin: clicking a field unit label converts the display; the model stays SI
PR panel: WinISD-mode Vas unit toggle (L → cu ft) still derives Cms/Mms correctly
